title: Consolidate Monorepo Into Single Files
description: Consolidate monorepo source into single files where frameworks allow. Keep required separate entry points (Vite main.ts, package.json subpath exports for puzzle plays, vitest/playwright configs). Merge playground core index+core, renderer boot into index, fold lint.script.ts into script.ts where present. Update imports and package exports. Run tests.
summary: Scattered-files consolidation slice: geometry/brep/js contracts+kernel+mesh→index.ts regions; repo/lib/js commit+micro-commit+uloc-metrics+shims→index.ts (index.test.ts imports updated); repo/client/vscode codegen/graphql+gql→extension.ts regions (codegen/ removed); mathematical/graph geometry+scene_json, port/directed types+scene_json, normal/board_host, normal/undirected/fixture_layout inlined into lib.rs; infinite/cavas/vello icon_codec+theme inlined into lib.rs; compose/client/lib/py store_test.py embedded in main.py. Verified: @semio-tech/geometry-brep-js tests pass, repo/lib 67/68 (1 pre-existing micro-commit draft test), cargo check on affected graph+vello crates, vscode vite build.
